lead.question: 渔民在马达加斯加附近捕到的“怪物”究竟是什么？为什么人们极少见到它？
lead.warmup: 大海深处藏着许多人类难得一见的东西。水手们总爱说自己在海上见过妖怪。可有时渔网里真的会拖出一条让人目瞪口呆的怪鱼：它力大无穷，能把小船拖出好几英里。它到底是传说中的海怪，还是一种我们还不了解的鱼？学完这一课，你会明白人们为什么把鱼当成妖怪，也会学到怎样用英语描述一次不寻常的捕捞。
goals: 掌握 claim to have seen 这类不定式完成式，理解动作先于谓语的表达。
会用 rarely、seldom、at times 描述罕见或偶发的现象，并知道它们自带否定意味。
能用 no ordinary fish、make every effort to、however 表达强调、努力与转折。
能读懂并复述这条“怪物”鱼的来历、外形以及被送进博物馆的经过。
lead.summary: 课文讲的是：渔夫和水手常声称在海里见过妖怪，但后来发现，这些“妖怪”多半只是奇怪的鱼，它们偶尔被冲上岸，却极少在海上被捕到。不久前，马达加斯加附近捕到一条怪鱼，它把小船拖到几英里外，身长超过十三英尺，头像马，蓝眼睛，银色皮肤，红尾巴。这条桨鱼被送进博物馆供科学家检查。
lead.tips: 易错提醒：rarely、seldom 本身含否定意义，变反意疑问句时要用肯定形式，如 They rarely go there, do they? 另外 no ordinary fish 的否定语气比 not an ordinary fish 更重。

questions.hint: 课文倒数第二句：The fish ... is called an oarfish.

questions.q: What happened to the small fishing boat?
questions.zh: 那条小渔船遭遇了什么？
questions.a: It was carried miles out to sea by the powerful fish as it pulled on the line.
questions.aZh: 那条力大无穷的鱼咬住鱼线，把小船拖到了几英里以外的海上。
questions.hint: 课文第 5 句，注意 out to sea 表示“向外海”。

questions.q: What did the fisherman do when he realized this was no ordinary fish?
questions.zh: 当渔民意识到这绝非一条普通的鱼时，他做了什么？
questions.a: He made every effort not to damage it in any way.
questions.aZh: 他千方百计不让它受到丝毫伤害。
questions.hint: 课文第 6 句，made every effort to 意为“尽一切努力”。

questions.q: What was the fish like when it was brought to shore?
questions.zh: 这条鱼被弄上岸时是什么样子？
questions.a: It was over thirteen feet long, with a head like a horse, big blue eyes, shining silver skin and a bright red tail.
questions.aZh: 它身长超过十三英尺，头像马，有大大的蓝眼睛、闪闪发光的银色皮肤和鲜红色的尾巴。
questions.hint: 课文第 7、8 句对其长度和外貌的描写。

questions.q: Why have such creatures rarely been seen alive by man?
questions.zh: 为什么人们很少能看到活着的这类动物？
questions.a: Because they live at a depth of six hundred feet, so they are rarely caught out at sea and are usually noticed only when they are washed to the shore.
questions.aZh: 因为它们生活在六百英尺深的水下，所以极少在海上被捕获，通常只有被冲上岸时才被人发现。
questions.hint: 结合最后一句以及第 3 句 they are rarely caught out at sea。

exercises.q: 汉译英：渔夫和水手们有时声称看到过海里的妖怪。
exercises.a: Fishermen and sailors sometimes claim to have seen monsters in the sea.
exercises.note: claim to have done 表动作已发生。

exercises.q: 汉译英：那位渔民意识到这根本不是一条普通的鱼，于是千方百计不让它受到丝毫伤害。
exercises.a: Realizing that this was no ordinary fish, the fisherman made every effort not to damage it in any way.
exercises.note: no ordinary 否定语气重于 not an。

exercises.q: 填空：It had a head like a horse, big blue eyes, shining silver skin, and a bright red ____.
exercises.note: tail 由形容词 red 修饰。

exercises.q: 填空：Such creatures have ____ been seen alive by man as they live at a depth of six hundred ____.
exercises.note: rarely 带否定；foot 复数为 feet。

exercises.q: 改错：Some time ago, but a peculiar fish was caught near Madagascar.
exercises.a: Some time ago, however, a peculiar fish was caught near Madagascar.
exercises.note: however 是连接副词，不与 but 连用。

exercises.q: 句型转换：用 seldom 改写 “Occasionally, unusual creatures are washed to the shore, but they are rarely caught out at sea.” 的后半句。
exercises.a: Occasionally, unusual creatures are washed to the shore, but they are seldom caught out at sea.
exercises.note: rarely 与 seldom 同义，均表否定。

exercises.q: 句型转换：把 “People have at times sighted many of these ‘monsters’.” 改为被动语态。
exercises.a: Many of these ‘monsters’ have at times been sighted by people.
exercises.note: sight 的被动式为 have been sighted。

quiz.q: 渔夫捕到的“怪物”实际上叫什么名字？
意识到这不是普通的鱼之后，渔民做了什么？
options: He made every effort not to damage it.
He cut the line at once.
He threw it back into the sea.
He sold it to a museum.
quiz.note: made every effort 意为“尽一切努力”。

quiz.q: “unusual creatures are washed to the shore”中 washed to the shore 的意思最接近哪一项？
options: Carried onto the land by the sea.
Cleaned by the fishermen on the beach.
Caught out at sea by a boat.
quiz.note: washed to the shore 即“被冲上岸”。

quiz.q: 下列哪个词可以替换 “they are rarely caught out at sea” 中的 rarely？
“Fishermen sometimes claim ____ monsters in the sea.” 空白处最恰当的是？
quiz.note: 不定式完成式表动作先于谓语。

quiz.q: 这条被捕获的鱼有多长？
quiz.note: 六百英尺是它生活的深度。
